text: Pursuant to Section 173(2) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, and the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 3, the Ombudsman is required to submit an annual report on the activities of his office directly to City Council.
City Council on May 10, 11 and 12, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the Ombudsman Toronto 2022 Annual Report for information.
